name: Liberty Extended
summary:
Liberty Extended is a comprehensive modification for Grand Theft Auto III that modernizes the original game while preserving its classic identity. Built around the re3 engine, the project introduces numerous gameplay improvements, new mechanics, visual enhancements, and quality-of-life features.

The mod adds features such as first-person camera, GPS navigation, modern controller support, improved vehicle physics and damage, vehicle additions, photo mode, dynamic lighting, distant lights, enhanced radar functionality, ModLoader support, and several other gameplay refinements.

Liberty Extended aims to provide a more modern way to experience Liberty City without replacing the core gameplay and atmosphere that defined Grand Theft Auto III.
